description: ask_human: the run pauses (`E1:q1`); the answer (`E1:0:1`) resumes the original tool call; the model asks again with the same provider id `ask_human:0` (as kimi does) and pauses (`E1:q2`); the second answer (`E1:0:2`) ends `succeeded`. Both tool results are in the third model request.
